articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed; avg 11 published per cycle; 0 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, every metric is within target, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05) bars a new one. Nothing was evaluated or changed.
weakestArea: Top-source share is the closest to its line: Al Jazeera supplied 10 of 59 stories (17% against a 20% cap), up from 8% yesterday. Science met its floor exactly at 5, down from 7, and one of its four sources is Investing.com.
watching: Gulf escalation: the IRGC says two more supertankers were hit and mines laid in Hormuz, and Trump is weighing post-midterm strikes on Iran.
Russia–Ukraine–US talks set for Abu Dhabi in November, alongside the Oleshky ceasefire and a drone strike that sank a cargo ship off Constanța.
Brazil's runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with inflation through the target ceiling and the ABIN 'paralela' note.
Sudan drone strikes killing hundreds across Khartoum, Nyala and Kurmuk.
The PHP2Shell exploitation surge, which took South Africa's presidency website offline.
Ebola Bundibugyo in Nigeria, which Africa CDC says is underestimated.
coverageGaps: Nine datelines are a country or state rather than a city (China ×2, Brazil ×2, United States, South Africa, Pakistan, Argentina, Alaska), which the missing-dateline metric does not catch.
Oceania carried one story (Hobart) and Africa four; the region floor still holds.
Two Hebron stories and two Argentina RIGI stories read as one developing thread each; the same-event check flagged neither, and they may be distinct angles.
context: Volume held at 59 for a second day; multi-source rose to 32% from 31%, and image URLs reached 100%. Two stories rest only on state or advocacy sources (the Bank of Russia hold, the Karak funeral shooting). Cycles averaged 1031s: selector 151s, writer 165s, editor 76s.
